name: closing line with mark and URL
looks: On a bold flat field the mark sits above a short closing headline. A URL in a small rounded pill sits beneath it, with the brand name in plain text at the very bottom.
build: Mark fades/scales in first; the headline fades/rises 6-8px in beneath it; the URL pill and byline fade in last on a short stagger, holding at least 1s.
sound: A soft confirm tone as the mark lands, the bed fading out under the hold.
prompt: Close on a bold flat field with the mark above a short closing line, a URL in a small rounded pill beneath it, and the brand name in plain text at the very bottom; hold the finished card for at least a second.
